svg.title: dot-agi work history
svg.text: Post-training data and evaluation infrastructure for frontier labs.
Lead the cybersecurity data track. Research reward hacking and
degenerate strategies in long-horizon agent tasks.
Vision foundation models for object re-identification and
discrimination. Shipped face recognition into production
surveillance; benchmarked recognition models on public datasets.
Agent observability SDKs rebuilt on OpenTelemetry. First-party
integrations across major LLM providers and agent frameworks,
plus E2E test and documentation automation.
LLM control for robotic arms, on-device small language models,
